environment.configReadEvidence: Live GPU-process worker observation for each launched browser: shots/software-runtime.json

runtimeObservation.method: Browser CDP SystemInfo.getProcessInfo; GPU /proc/task/comm worker names after labReady; no process arguments or environment values

stabilityScope: Chromium in the cloud at phone viewport; this is not a physical phone GPU measurement.
buildTimingMethod: Initial source geometry/material/texture construction in each fresh browser context; excludes shader compile/GPU upload and asset download. Captures that switch quality record rebuilding; phone trials preserve the first startup build.

after.source: procedural mobile; exported and roundtrip checked

beforeAfter.fullModelPairResizing: one common crop and one uniform scale per before/after pair
beforeAfter.headCropMethod: fixed raster crop from the full-model camera; identical before and after
beforeAfter.lightingNote: Both models share these live scene lights. Each model retains its own baked vertex colours and materials.

reference.modelCropMethod: common precise projected before/after skinned bounds plus 8 CSS pixels

rigid.onlyDifference: skin weights rounded to their dominant bone; source geometry, camera, materials and lights unchanged

pbr.description: source materials retained; same source geometry and studio camera/light presets as final

phone.animation: stand → run → kick → stand; 1.2 s per leg; cosine eased
phone.expressionAnimation: happy → effort → surprised → victory → tired → thinking → happy; 0.6 s per leg; cosine eased

phoneBaseline.animation: stand → run → kick → stand; 1.2 s per leg; cosine eased
phoneBaseline.expressionAnimation: happy → effort → surprised → victory → tired → thinking → happy; 0.6 s per leg; cosine eased
phoneBaseline.modelSource: preserved original GLB loaded through the same lab scene
phoneBaseline.timingMethod: loadAndFirstDrawMs measures local GLB loading/parsing and first completed draw; embedded source procedural buildMs is deliberately omitted.

phoneDelivered.animation: stand → run → kick → stand; 1.2 s per leg; cosine eased
phoneDelivered.expressionAnimation: happy → effort → surprised → victory → tired → thinking → happy; 0.6 s per leg; cosine eased
phoneDelivered.modelSource: delivered GLB loaded through the same lab scene
phoneDelivered.timingMethod: loadAndFirstDrawMs measures local GLB loading/parsing and first completed draw; embedded source procedural buildMs is deliberately omitted.

expressionComparison.cameraAndLights: identical full-body studio; fixed head raster crops
